name: Children Going To Hell
overview: Scripture reveals that even children are recognized by their actions and moral choices, as Proverbs 20:11 states, emphasizing that their deeds reflect their character. Discipline and correction are necessary and do not bring death, but rather guide children away from wrongdoing (Proverbs 23:13; Luke 12:48). Jesus teaches the seriousness of sin and the eternal consequences of unrepented offense, warning that it is better to lose a part of oneself than to enter hell (Mark 9:43). While children are precious in the kingdom of heaven (Matthew 18:1), the Bible underscores the responsibility to nurture and correct them according to God's standards, highlighting the reality that all who sin without repentance face judgment.
